items.answer: Module src/ratings/notch.mjs. RATING_SCALE: the 19 strings of C1 in best-first order (AAA … CCC-). notchChange(previous: string, current: string) → integer = index(current) - index(previous), range -18..+18 (AAA→CCC- = 18, CCC-→AAA = -18). Unchanged returns 0, and it must be +0 (assert.strictEqual distinguishes -0). Each argument is trimmed with String.prototype.trim() and matched case-insensitively before lookup. Exact export form and immutability are covered by X-module-shape (pm).

items.answer: Every invalid argument throws RangeError: an unknown rating ('D', 'BBB +', 'Baa1'), '' or whitespace-only (''/'   ' after trim), and any non-string (undefined, null, 3, {}, new String('A')).
